title: Two Years Later, Jujutsu Kaisen’s Ending Is As Controversial As Fans Remember
content: There’s no denying Jujutsu Kaisen is one of the biggest Shonen Jump series of all time, even though it was only released in recent years. Written and illustrated by Gege Akutami, the manga began serialization in Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 2018 before reaching its conclusion in 2024.

title: Smells Like Green Spirit's Saburō Nagai Launches New Manga
content: Shinchosha 's Kurage Bunch magazine announced on Monday Saburō Nagai will launch a new boys-love series titled Iei ga Nai! (There's No Deceased Portrait!) in the magazine on Tuesday.

title: Naruto Gets New 'Limited' TV Anime Series
content: Viz Media announced on Monday that the Naruto franchise will have a new television anime "limited" series. The "NARUTO: What's Next?" panel at New York Comic Con will announce details about the new anime on October 10 at 5:00 p.m. EDT (2:00 p.m. PDT or October 11 at 6:00 a.m. JST) .

title: Bottom-Tier Character Tomozaki Novels End with 12th Volume
content: Yūki Yaku announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Wednesday that his Bottom-tier Character Tomozaki ( Jaku-chara Tomozaki-kun ) light novel series will end in the 12th volume on October 16.

title: Crunchyroll’s Solo Leveling Replacement for Fall 2026 Has Finally Arrived, And It’s Better Than Expected
content: The Fall 2026 anime season has arrived, bringing all sorts of anime with it, and Crunchyroll , as the major streaming platform for anime, is serving them all. title: Chiikawa Anime Film Drops to #2, Star Detective Precure! Film Stays at #3
content: Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, dropped from #1 to #2 in its 10th weekend in Japan's box office from Friday to Sunday.
